description:
Is the smart money long or short this coin? For a Hyperliquid perp ticker, shows how the 120 Hyperliquid accounts with the highest 30-day PnL (public leaderboard) are positioned now: bias (strong long to strong short), traders long vs short, snapshot age and coverage. Free preview tier. Paid tiers add notional and 1h/24h flows (lite) or entries, leverage, liquidation bands and top positions (coin).
Not for: placing trades, spot markets or non-Hyperliquid venues; for a market-wide scan use smart_money_scan. Read-only analytics on public data; not financial advice.

[SmartPerps via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as SmartPerps's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.003 / coin $0.02 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.
